move: blue rounded square scales up with overshoot, four glyph tiles pop in, echo square expands behind, hover, scale out
how: A rounded blue square holding an SVG of four small rounded rects, an echo square div behind it, and a name below. 0-40%: the square scales 0->1 from rotation -12 with back.out(1.8); from 17% the four rects pop from scale 0 with back.out(2.5), 0.06s stagger. At 7% the echo scales .2->2.2 while fading .3->0 (power3.out, 1.1s). At 30% the name fades up 18px (power3.out). At 50% the square hovers y -8 in a sine yoyo. Exit at 80%: the square shrinks to 0 rotating 12 with back.in(1.8) and the name lifts and fades.
adapt: Replace the blue (#1d4ed8), the inner SVG glyphs and the name. Keep the 0.8s back.out(1.8) scale-in, the 0.06s glyph stagger and the 1.1s echo expansion.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the shadow, square and name inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with scale-in at 0, glyphs at 0.17D, echo at 0.07D, hover at 0.5D, exit at 0.8D. Scope '.sq', '.sq svg rect', '.shadow', '.name' to el; the from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested.
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested
